parameters.query:
DECLARE @inst sysname = N'{{$node["Set - Params"].json["instance_name"]}}';

SELECT mi.instance_id,
       s.base_datos,
       s.last_state,
       s.last_change_utc
FROM OpsObservability.dbo.monitoring_instance mi WITH (NOLOCK)
LEFT JOIN OpsObservability.dbo.monitoring_backup_state s WITH (NOLOCK)
  ON s.instance_id = mi.instance_id
WHERE mi.instance_name = @inst;
